grammar.summary: 本课学习表假设研究的 it is conceivable 与 as such。

points.title: 表"可设想"的 it is conceivable that
points.explanation: It is conceivable that... = 可以设想……。学术推想的虚拟化表达，与 it is believed 平行。

examples.en: It is conceivable that sleep serves a protective function.
examples.cn: 可以设想睡眠具有保护功能。

points.title: 表「出于」的 in terms of / on the part of
points.explanation: interest on the part of researchers 表"研究者的兴趣"。on the part of sb. = 就某人而言。

examples.en: This has aroused great interest on the part of scientists.
examples.cn: 这激起了科学家们的极大兴趣。
